query: select (select count(*) from Ticket where status <> 'resolved') as open, (select count(*) from Ticket where status <> 'resolved' and severity in ('high', 'critical')) as urgent, (select round(avg((julianday(resolved) - julianday(created)) * 24), 1) from Ticket where resolved is not null) as hoursToResolve, (select count(distinct a.id) from Application a join Software s on s.id = a.software join vulnerability v on v.vendor = s.vendor and v.software = s.name join cve on cve.id = v.cve where s.id <> 'linux_kernel') as exposedApps, (select count(*) from Host) as hosts
